comment: Git Crafter's own values for tools/apply_setup.mjs --values: the per-repo rows of templates/setup.json (topics, homepage, description), as the repo holds them on 2026-11-23 (gh api repos). optional_on lists the optional rows this repo turns on; it turns on the Secret Protection rows it holds or the owner chose (the owner keeps Secret Protection, 2026-11-25).
